title: Only 1/10 Can Pass This Catholic Trivia Quiz
summary: Explore Catholic Foundations, Sacraments and Seasons, Prayer and Scripture, Faith in Practice, Making Connections across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Explore faith and tradition.
How much will you remember?

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Catholic Foundations, Sacraments and Seasons, Prayer and Scripture, Faith in Practice, Making Connections. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not religious instruction or a judgement of faith.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not religious instruction or a judgement of faith.

catholic-q1.question: In the Roman Rite, what is the central celebration of the Eucharist called?

catholic-q2.question: The Pope is also the bishop of which city?

catholic-round1-new1.question: Which sacrament is normally the entry into Christian life?

answers.a1: A local Church community entrusted to a bishop

catholic-q3.question: How many sacraments does the Catholic Church recognise?

catholic-q4.question: In the Roman Rite, which season of the Church year comes immediately before Christmas?

catholic-round2-new1.question: Which sacrament concerns reconciliation after sin?

catholic-round2-new2.question: What does Easter celebrate in Christian belief?

catholic-round2-new3.question: What does Christmas celebrate in Christian belief?

answers.a2: The descent of the Holy Spirit

catholic-round2-new4.question: In the Roman Rite, what liturgical colour is commonly associated with Ordinary Time?

catholic-q5.question: Which set of Rosary mysteries was introduced by Pope John Paul II in 2002?

catholic-q6.question: Which book comes first in the Catholic Bible?

catholic-round3-new2.question: What is a decade of the Rosary traditionally built around?

catholic-round3-new3.question: What is the Bible's Book of Psalms especially associated with?

catholic-round3-new4.question: Who are Matthew, Mark, Luke and John traditionally known as?

catholic-q7.question: Which sacrament strengthens baptismal grace and is associated with the gifts of the Holy Spirit?

catholic-q8.question: How many Stations of the Cross are traditionally observed?

answers.a1: A local community of the faithful within a diocese

catholic-round4-new2.question: What is a homily normally intended to do?

answers.a1: Explain and apply the scriptural readings and faith
answers.a4: Serve as a civil court judgment

catholic-round4-new3.question: What is the sacrament of Matrimony concerned with?

answers.a4: The blessing of a building only

catholic-round4-new4.question: What is Holy Orders associated with?

catholic-q9.question: In the Roman Rite, which day begins Lent?

answers.a2: The descent of the Holy Spirit

catholic-round5-new1.question: What does the Ascension celebrate in Christian belief?

answers.a1: A journey with a religious purpose to a sacred place

catholic-round5-new4.question: Why specify 'Roman Rite' in some Catholic liturgy questions?

answers.a1: Catholic liturgical traditions are not all identical
answers.a2: The Catholic Church has no other traditions
answers.a4: It means the question applies only inside Rome
